WITH root_page AS ( SELECT c.id, c.floor, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.root_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.reply_count, c.create_time FROM comment c WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.floor ASC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize} ), ranked_replies AS ( SELECT c.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY c.root_id ORDER BY c.create_time ASC, c.id ASC ) AS row_num FROM comment c INNER JOIN root_page p ON p.id = c.root_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND c.deleted = 0 ) SELECT p.id AS floor_id, p.floor AS floor_no, p.user_id AS floor_user_id, p.parent_id AS floor_parent_id, p.root_id AS floor_root_id, p.content AS floor_content, p.like_count AS floor_like_count, p.reply_count AS floor_reply_count, p.create_time AS floor_create_time,
r.id AS reply_id, r.floor AS reply_floor, r.user_id AS reply_user_id, r.parent_id AS reply_parent_id, r.root_id AS reply_root_id, r.content AS reply_content, r.like_count AS reply_like_count, r.reply_count AS reply_reply_count, r.create_time AS reply_create_time FROM root_page p LEFT JOIN ranked_replies r ON r.root_id = p.id AND r.row_num <= #{replyLimit} ORDER BY p.floor ASC, p.id ASC, r.create_time ASC, r.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND parent_id IS NULL AND deleted = 0
